title: Weekend Dispatch Overlap — Mobile In-Home Collection Visit Billing Clause
content:
## Clause — Specimen Collection Appointments

The weekend amount of a Saturday or Sunday home visit is multiplied by a dispatch overlap factor. Compare the visit's assessed trip fee — the amount of the assessed trip fee line on the visit's fee record — with the listed trip fee of the zone it was booked in (75.00 for zone 1, 95.00 for zone 2, 125.00 for zone 3):

- when the assessed trip fee is **1.25 times that listed fee or more**, the weekend dispatch has already been charged in the trip and the weekend amount is multiplied by **0.50**;
- when it is **above the listed fee but below 1.25 times it**, the weekend amount is multiplied by **0.75**;
- otherwise the weekend amount is taken in full.

## Thresholds

| Zone booked | Listed trip fee | 1.25 times the listed fee | Weekend amount multiplied by 0.50 when the assessed trip fee is | Multiplied by 0.75 when it is | Taken in full when it is |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Service zone 1 | 75.00 | 93.75 | 93.75 or more | Above 75.00 and below 93.75 | 75.00 or less |
| Service zone 2 | 95.00 | 118.75 | 118.75 or more | Above 95.00 and below 118.75 | 95.00 or less |
| Service zone 3 | 125.00 | 156.25 | 156.25 or more | Above 125.00 and below 156.25 | 125.00 or less |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical Mobile In-Home Collection Visits)

| Zone booked | Assessed trip fee | Weekend amount multiplied by |
|---|---|---|
| Zone 2 | 118.75 | 0.50 — exactly 1.25 times counts as "or more" |
| Zone 2 | 118.74 | 0.75 |
| Zone 2 | 95.01 | 0.75 |
| Zone 2 | 95.00 | Full — equal to the listed fee is not above it |
| Zone 1 | 60.00 | Full |
